title: COMNAVSECGRU Visual Sighting Report, April 30, 1979
doc_notes: This document contains a description of a visual sighting on page 2, while page 1 is entirely unrelated text regarding a video game.

incidents.summary: A central core of light with a colored beam retracted into a nebulous cloud-shaped mass and drifted south.
incidents.quote: THE BEAM AND CORE SEEMED TO FORM INTO A NEBULOUS CLOUD-SHAPED MASS
